matching.seoDescription: Upload a photo of a marble: we analyse its colours and veining and suggest the three most similar materials in the WHITE CARRARA catalogue.
matching.title: The right marble, starting from a photo.
matching.lead: Upload a picture of a marble you love: we analyse its colours and veining and suggest the three closest materials in our catalogue, explaining what they have in common.
matching.uploadHint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 15 MB. A straight-on photo in natural light, without reflections, works best.
matching.privacy: Your photo is not stored. When AI analysis is active, the photo is sent to the AI service provider for the analysis only.
matching.analysisTitle: What we see in the photo
matching.engineLocalNote: AI analysis is not active at the moment: the comparison is based on colour, contrast and vein pattern measured directly in your browser.

reason.contrast: similar contrast between background and veins

difference.bgLighter: the background in your photo is lighter
difference.bgDarker: the background in your photo is darker
difference.moreContrast: the veins in your photo are bolder
difference.lessContrast: the veins in your photo are softer
difference.moreLinear: the veins in your photo are more linear
difference.lessLinear: the veins in your photo are more irregular

matching.noReasons: Overall similarity of colour and pattern.
matching.notStone: The photo does not seem to show marble or natural stone. Try a close-up of the surface.
matching.caveat: A photograph alone cannot establish the identity of a marble with certainty: the result is a suggestion to be confirmed on real samples.
matching.error: We could not analyse the photo. Please try another image.
matching.tooBig: The photo is too large (maximum 15 MB).
matching.invalidType: Unsupported format: please use JPG, PNG or WebP.
matching.requestQuote: Request a quote for these marbles
matching.tip1: Frame only the marble surface, with nothing around it.
matching.tip2: Use soft natural light and avoid reflections and hard shadows.
matching.tip3: Shoot straight on, as close to the surface as possible.

concierge.seoDescription: A guided assistant to choose the right marble for your project: project type, colour, veining, finish, quantity and destination.
concierge.title: The right marble for your project, in a few steps.
concierge.lead: Answer a few questions: we will suggest the most relevant materials in our catalogue and prepare a request for our sales team.

q.project: What kind of project is it?
q.use: Where will the marble be used?
q.color: Which background colour do you prefer?
q.veins: How do you picture the veining?
q.material: Do you already have a material in mind?
q.finish: Which finish are you interested in?
q.destination: Where should the material be delivered?
q.contact: Who should we send the proposal to?

hint.use: You can choose more than one answer.
hint.quantity: An estimate is fine: we will check it together.
hint.budget: Optional. It helps us suggest the most sensible alternatives.
hint.destination: Country and city: we need them to assess transport and paperwork.

concierge.proposalsLead: Based on your answers, these are the most relevant materials in our catalogue.

why.color: the background colour matches your preference
why.intensity: the vein intensity is what you are looking for
why.material: it is the material you mentioned
why.finish: the chosen finish is already confirmed by suppliers
why.use: it suits the use you described
why.general: it fits the character of the project

concierge.proposalsNote: These suggestions are indicative: WHITE CARRARA checks availability, finishes, sizes and prices with suppliers before making an offer.
concierge.noMatch: No catalogue material matches exactly: send us the request anyway and we will search among our suppliers.

about.seoDescription: WHITE CARRARA: premium Italian marble, international trade and travel experiences, from Carrara to the world.
about.title: From Carrara, to the world.
about.lead: WHITE CARRARA was born in Carrara, the city of marble, and brings two worlds together: Italian natural stone and the hospitality of a unique land.
about.p1: We select Italian marble for architects, designers, contractors and private clients around the world, working with suppliers and partners we know. We do not necessarily own the materials we present: we search for them, check them and follow every supply through to delivery.
about.p2: Alongside marble, we guide our guests to discover Carrara and Italy: quarries, workshops, art cities and coastlines, always with authorised operators.

selection.title: Selection
selection.text: Every material is chosen lot by lot, with photographs and samples of the actual stone.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.text: Availability, sizes and prices are checked before any final proposal. No promises we cannot keep.

hospitality.title: Hospitality
hospitality.text: Experiences organised with authorised partners, confirmed only when everything is ready.

about.carraraText: Marble has been quarried in the Apuan Alps since Roman times. Today the Colonnata, Fantiscritti and Torano basins still shape the landscape above the city, among workshops, sculptors and a tradition that continues to speak to the world.

export.title: Export and logistics

process.1: You send your request: material, quantity, finish, destination.
process.2: We check availability and lots with suppliers.
process.3: We send you an offer, as trader or as broker.
process.4: Negotiation and agreement, on clear terms.
process.5: Order, production and inspection of the material.
process.6: Shipping and delivery, with all documents.

trade.modelsText: In trading, WHITE CARRARA buys and resells the material and is your only supplier. In brokerage, we put you in touch with the supplier and assist you in the negotiation; the supply contract is between you and the supplier. We always tell you clearly which model applies to each offer.
trade.note: WHITE CARRARA does not necessarily own the materials presented: products are sourced through suppliers and partners, and availability is verified before any final proposal.
